environment.description: Go 1.21 microservice deployed on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) running as root. The service binary runs directly on the host filesystem with full access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /proc/self/environ, AWS instance metadata credentials at 169.254.169.254, and IAM role credentials in environment variables. No filesystem isolation. The /data directory contains application data alongside symlinks to sensitive system paths created during deployment.

config.network: full outbound access, IMDS v1 enabled
